headline: Premier League panel: Harry Maguire goal vs. Ipswich right to stand, Arsenal deserved penalty vs. Aston Villa
description: The Premier League's Key Match Incidents (KMI) panel has said the decision to allow a Man United goal against Ipswich after an apparent handball by Maguire was correct and added that VAR should have intervened to award Arsenal a penalty against Villa.

headline: Marcus Rashford returns to training ahead of Manchester United's Champions League clash
description: Marcus Rashford trained as normal with the Manchester United squad on Wednesday ahead of the Champions League tie with Sabah FK.

headline: Gabriel Jesus: I was made to train alone at Arsenal before Barcelona move
description: Gabriel Jesus has said he was made to train alone at Arsenal this summer as the club sought to move him on during the transfer window.

headline: Ex-Liverpool, Real Oviedo midfielder Ovie Ejaria takes to LinkedIn in new club search
description: Former Liverpool and Real Oviedo midfielder Ovie Ejaria has taken to LinkedIn as he bids to find a new club.

headline: Xabi Alonso insists Estêvão remains integral part of Chelsea plans despite limited minutes
description: Xabi Alonso insists Estêvão remains an important part of his plans despite limited opportunities for the young Brazilian so far.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United blow as Hall agrees new Newcastle deal
description: Manchester United target Lewis Hall has reportedly agreed a new contract with Newcastle United. Transfer Talk has the latest.
